items.q: I recommended Ben, and he got Johnny Hodges, and when I came in for the record date

ctx.x: Did you recommend Bill? Were you the one who recommended Bill?
I recommended Ben, and he got Johnny Hodges, and when I came in for the record date, I was surprised that he got what's his name on trombone.
